author: Poag
description: Automatic voice channel creation. When a member joins an AutoVoice Source (voice channel), this cog moves them into a brand new voice channel that they own, in a chosen destination category. Once everyone leaves it, the channel is automatically deleted. Members can rename, resize, and lock down their own room; server admins configure which source channels create rooms, what type of room they create (public/locked/private/server-owned), and how rooms are named. This is a from-scratch reimplementation of PhasecoreX's AutoRoom cog with its legacy companion text channel feature dropped (superseded by Discord's built-in voice channel text chat), and includes a one-time `[p]autovoiceset migrate` command to import an existing AutoRoom setup (sources, per-room settings, and currently open rooms) without disruption.
install_msg: Thanks for installing AutoVoice! Get started with `[p]autovoiceset create <source> <category>`. If you're migrating from AutoRoom, see the repo README's 'Migrating from AutoRoom' section for the `[p]autovoiceset migrate` workflow.
short: Automatic voice channel creation and management.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per voice channel it creates: the Discord user ID of the channel's owner (if any), and a list of Discord user IDs denied access to it. This is used only to restore ownership/access-control state across bot restarts and re-apply deny lists to rejoining members. All stored data referencing a user is deleted when Red processes a data deletion request for that user.
